newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO, Israel formally sign Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: PLO, Israel formally sign Hebron deal.

text.p: The PLO and Israel formally signed the deal on Friday for an Israeli pullout from most of Hebron and for three future West Bank handovers, a PLO official said.

"We formally signed the protocol behind closed doors 10 minutes ago in Jerusalem," said the PLO negotiator Saeb Erekat. The signing took place hours after Israel transferred 80 percent of the West Bank town of Hebron to the Palestinians.
Erekat said he had already signed the deal at a ceremony on Wednesday. But Israeli negotiator Dan Shomron had only initialed it.

"Since the deal was only initialed by Shomron, he needed to sign the deal, so I was called to attend the ceremony and I signed again," Erekat told Reuters. He said the ceremony was attended only by U.S. Consul General Edward Abington.
Israel, which confirmed the formal signing in a statement, handed over most of Hebron to Palestinian rule at dawn on Friday after 30 years of occupation.
Israel will retain about one fifth of the city where some 400 militant Jewish settlers live.
